parameters.name: ActionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the rule action to query.

You can obtain the rule action ID by using the following methods:
- Call [CreateRuleAction](~~69586~~) and view the value of the **ActionId** parameter in the response.
- Call [ListRuleActions](~~69517~~) and view the value of the **Id** parameter in the response.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page is displayed or no </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
